rationale: Revised plan corrects two critical evaluation failures: (1) denial_rate denominator changed from 'all_claims' to 'adjudicated_claims' to correctly exclude Pended claims, which have not been decided; adjudicated claims (Paid, Denied, Adjusted) provide the proper baseline for the denial rate, addressing high-severity feedback T2-denial_rate_denominator. (2) monthly_trend date_column changed from 'adjudication_date' to 'service_date_from' to reflect when care was delivered, not when claims were decided; service dates are more consistent and better represent care delivery timing, addressing medium-severity feedback T2-monthly_date_column. All other components remain unchanged as they passed evaluation. All required artifacts will continue to be produced.
changes_summary: Two parameter corrections: (1) denial_rate denominator 'all_claims' → 'adjudicated_claims' to properly exclude Pended claims and compute the denial rate over adjudicated claims (Paid, Denied, Adjusted) only. (2) monthly_trend date_column 'adjudication_date' → 'service_date_from' to reflect the timing of care delivery rather than claim adjudication. These changes address the critical evaluation failures and align with statistical discipline and correctness criteria.
